vetSays.line: 🛡️ Theo, Lisa, Pearl, Ivan and Oliver met them at the door — 5 put down. Lisa, Pearl, Ivan, Oliver are hurt.

📺 "Oh, you survived the AUDIENCE NOTES? Cute. We've stopped pretending these are animals now. That was the FINAL DRAFT, folks — what comes out of the treeline next was never alive the way you mean it."
🛡️ Jordan, Theo, Dale, David and Giulia met them at the door — 5 put down. Theo, Dale, David, Giulia are hurt.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Pearl just put down Chorus Line... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Ivan just put down Ad Break... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Theo, Lisa, Pearl, Ivan and David met them at the door — 3 put down, 2 barely walked away. Lisa, Pearl, Ivan, David are hurt.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Pearl just put down Big Ugly... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 "We've been watching you for a LONG time. Your faiths. Your formats. Your little institutions. So we built something out of... well. Out of YOU. Say hello to the MIRROR DRAFT."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Pearl just put down The Strike... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 "You've gotten too big for the story. Ratings are GREAT, by the way — but you're threatening the narrative now. So the narrative is fighting back. Meet the PRODUCERS."
Blooded — the village knows where the Producers bleed. (Strikes hit 1.5× as hard; their blows land at 0.75× strength.)

◈ SYSTEM: "Four waves. FOUR. The producers are — okay, I'm saying it: FINALES need a NATION. You've got a region; now make it a REALM. Bind fires under one head, or bend the knee to someone who has. The higher-ups are watching. ...Did I say higher-ups? I said NOTHING. Forget the higher-ups."

◈ ARC IV — THE INEFFICIENCY. SYSTEM: "ROUNDING ERROR RECLASSIFIED: ANOMALY. Organic consumption yields impossible output. Recalculating. Recalculating." — They finally see it. The thing they laughed at — needing to EAT — is the engine. Their confusion is your weapon now. You stood up to the calibration fauna, the audience's notes, the Final Draft — lived through their Show, weathered the worst together, and built something bigger than a village. One day humanity will need a case to make. The case is made of deeds, not words — and yours, though unfinished, are undeniable. (Feasted buffs burn ho

killerTaleLog: [day 11] Jordan: The fire settles. Jordan has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "Rut King — I put it down today." "He lowers the crown. Paws the earth once, twice. The whole forest holds its breath." "His chest swells. The inhale goes on too long — cover your ears or get behind something." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Dale asks "And you're still standing." Lisa asks "The fire feels smaller now." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"

[day 13] Dale: The fire settles. Dale has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "Hushpuppy — I put it down today." "No telegraph you can hear. Watch the birds — when they go quiet, the pack is already moving." "The pack circles — nips from the edge, never committing." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Giulia breathes "So it bleeds." Ivan breathes "Did it look at you? Before?" Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"

[day 14] Carlos: The fire settles. Carlos has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "Night Court — I put it down today." "No sound. That is the warning. The moon-shadow on the ground is growing — and there is no sound at all. Owls don't make sound when they hunt." "It missed — and it is already turning. The second dive re-aims at where you moved." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Dale says quietly "We've been walking past those." Lisa says quietly "We've been walking past those." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"

[day 20] Theo: The fire settles. Theo has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "Drum-Belly — I put it down today." "It rears up, belly swelling drum-taut, and beats it with both paws — BOOM. The air itself flinches." "It waddles left, then is suddenly right — a feint, testing whether your eyes or your ears are in charge." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Pearl asks "We've been walking past those." Oliver mutters "Did it look at you? Before?" Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"

[day 20] Oliver: The fire settles. Oliver has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "Murkcap — I put it down today." "The gills begin to breathe — a sweet, wrong smell rolls out from under the cap. The air shimmers." "The cap tilts. The stem creaks like a ship's mast. Get out from under it." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Lisa says "We've been walking past those." Dale says quietly "Did it look at you? Before?" Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"

[day 23] Oliver: The fire settles. Oliver has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "Nevermore — I put it down today." "Its shadow detaches from the branch-shadow and slides across the ground toward you — a straight black lane, growing. The bird hasn't moved. The shadow has." "It climbs, laughing in a dead voice — out of spear reach, watching." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Pearl asks "We've been walking past those." Lisa mutters "Say that again — slower." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"

[day 26] Carlos: The fire settles. Carlos has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "The Heckler — I put it down today." "'You call that a swing?' The words CUT. Shame stacks." "'Oh, it's TRYING again!' Double shame — it smells blood." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Theo asks "Did it look at you? Before?" David says "Tell me you didn't go alone." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"

[day 27] Jordan: The fire settles. Jordan has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "Choir Toad — I put it down today." "Its throat swells. The air goes thick. Every frog for a mile answers at once." "It crouches — clumsy, obvious, and faster than it looks." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. David breathes "And you're still standing." Dale says quietly "So it bleeds." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"

[day 27] Theo: The fire settles. Theo has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "Mosquito — I put it down today." "Whining, closing. It circles — the sound gets closer." "The whine steadies — DIVE. Telegraphed." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. David says quietly "Did it look at you? Before?" Pearl says quietly "Did it look at you? Before?" Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"

[day 27] Dale: The fire settles. Dale has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "Hummice — I put it down today." "A low hum rises from the grass. It harmonizes with itself. Your teeth ache." "Teeth in the grass, everywhere at once — a tide of small bites." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. David asks "So it bleeds." Ivan breathes "So it bleeds." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"

[day 27] David: The fire settles. David has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "Inspiration — I put it down today." "It brightens. The light is too white, too certain. EUREKA — the biggest burst so far." "It flickers — a smaller, meaner idea. Less certain, faster." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Dale asks "The fire feels smaller now." Pearl says quietly "Tell me you didn't go alone." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"

[day 33] Pearl: The fire settles. Pearl has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "Flashbulb Moth — I put it down today." "It lands. It folds its wings. The light in the clearing changes, like someone adjusting a lamp." "It lets go of the air and simply... drifts. Somewhere else. Hard to predict." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. David asks "We've been walking past those." Theo breathes "And you're still standing." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"

[day 35] Oliver: The fire settles. Oliver has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "Ducks in a row — I put it down today." "The hissing stops. The line leans forward — it advances, and contact burns." "Every beak in the line, one coordinated bite." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Lisa says quietly "Say that again — slower." Ivan asks "And you're still standing." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"

[day 36] Theo: The fire settles. Theo has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "Sweeps Week — I put it down today." "The grass stops moving the way wind moves it. Two amber eyes — then the whole striped avalanche." "It circles, unhurried. It has seen this episode before — and it knows how it ends." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Oliver mutters "We've been walking past those." Pearl breathes "And you're still standing." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"

[day 37] Theo: The fire settles. Theo has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "White Noise — I put it down today." "The heron is gone. No — it's there. It was always there. You just couldn't see it until it moved." "You blink. It is somewhere else. You didn't see it move." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Pearl says "Tell me you didn't go alone." Lisa mutters "Did it look at you? Before?" Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"

[day 38] Theo: The fire settles. Theo has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "The Focus Group — I put it down today." "The murmur rises — you can HEAR them deliberating. They're about to love your dodge and hate your strike. The ratings are honest and visible." "The lead mouth-head clears its throat — the opening question, focus-grouped and focus-grouped again: ‘So... how does that make you FEEL?’" A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Oliver says "Tell me you didn't go alone." Ivan says "And you're still standing." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"

[day 40] Pearl: The fire settles. Pearl has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "Chorus Line — I put it down today." "The music starts — an actual audio cue, 4/4, and you can feel the downbeat coming. The downbeat is the kick. Deafness breaks the telegraph but not the beat." "The count stutters — ONE-two-THREE-and— the kick comes on the off-beat, where your dancing feet aren’t." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Lisa asks "The fire feels smaller now." Dale breathes "We've been walking past those." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"

[day 48] Dale: The fire settles. Dale has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "The Mountain Lord — I put it down today." "It crouches low, tail lashing once, twice. The stripes go still. Then it comes." "A paw rises, claws out — casual, almost lazy. It is not lazy." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Agostina asks "The fire feels smaller now." Lisa mutters "We've been walking past those." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"

[day 115] Giulia: The fire settles. Giulia has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "Sunbasker — I put it down today." "Its scales go from dull brown to molten gold. Heat shimmers off its back. It's ready." "It goes still in the sun. Gold spreads across its back — the charge is building." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. David breathes "Tell me you didn't go alone." Agostina says "Tell me you didn't go alone." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"
vetKillerTaleLog: [day 58] Pearl: The fire settles. Pearl leans in, and the hall goes quiet in a different way — this is not a new story. "You all know The Strike by now. I put another one down today." "The rat's eyes INFLATE before a shutdown — and it posts its demands first, a real readable list. Your abilities, your items, the grid itself goes on strike: dead turns where nothing works. The strike is always announced." "Work-to-rule. Every gear turns at exactly the minimum. The slowdown is a thousand small cuts, all of them on you." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Giulia mutters "Tell me you didn't go alone." Ivanka says "We've been walking past those." Someone at the edge of the light nods, slow. "We know the name. We know the hand, too."
